caption_summary: Long: opens with a comment-to-get-the-group-link CTA, retells the bath mistake as a mini story, explains the new age-based ritual guide and that it lives in her free secret Instagram sleep group
what_makes_it_work: A confident first-person warning with a precise number sits over a calm photo of the expert and leads straight to a free gated guide, and the comments (127 on 46 likes) show people replying for the link. The slide 9 pitch is the whole conversion mechanism.
lumebook_takeaway: A free gated guide offered in the comments, introduced by a warning hook, can generate far more comments than likes; a kids' book brand could offer a free story or age guide the same way.
